Overview

Katowice is a city in Silesian with a population of 290,710. The heart of the Silesian metropolitan area, transformed from a coal mining center into a modern hub for business, technology, and culture. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
